input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns provision with no consent standard, so HDI may assign the Agreement (including to a competitor of ours) without our consent. That fails even the fallback, which requires consent for non-successor assignments not to be unreasonably withheld. We add one concise sentence at the preferred position: Company freedom to assign to an affiliate or to a merger/acquisition/asset-sale successor, HDI assignment gated on our consent not unreasonably withheld with an absolute competitor bar, and no HDI termination right on our change of control.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets; HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company; and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns sentence, so HDI could assign to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. We have added one sentence keeping our freedom to assign to an affiliate or M&A successor, gating HDI assignments on our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a competitor bar, and confirming our change of control gives HDI no termination right.
proposal.summary: Insert assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/M&A successors; HDI needs our consent, no competitor assignment, no HDI termination on our change of control.
